q: When is FCM the wrong tool on its own?
o: Delivery must be guaranteed or auditable
A nudge for a small group
why: Use an inbox or SMS as the source of truth, with push as a prompt.

q: Which fits a PWA with no native app?
why: Browsers have their own standard push.

q: A walkie-talkie that stays connected is best built with …
o: a socket for audio, and FCM to wake and reconnect
why: Push wakes the app; the live part needs a socket or WebRTC.

q: Phones without Google Play Services need …
o: another route, such as UnifiedPush or polling
why: FCM on Android depends on Play Services.
